subject: Quick thought on the Horizon Dental Center website + live prototype
body:
Hi Horizon Dental team,

I always appreciate finding local practices like yours in Omaha that offer such a comprehensive range of care, from standard preventative cleanings to specialized treatments like apicoectomies and dental bone grafting in a calm environment.

While reviewing your current site, I noticed a couple of friction points that might be slowing down new patient inquiries—specifically, having to navigate away to a separate page to book an appointment, and the lack of an embedded direct booking widget or click-to-call tracking for your Google Business Profile traffic.

To see how these could be smoothed out, I went ahead and built a clean, modern preview of your site here: https://nayom-biz-0x8793f303f431668b-0xa286ab5bfec0bb2.vercel.app

Feel free to check out the live preview. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Embedded interactive booking widget to reduce appointment friction
Click-to-call tracking on phone numbers for Google Business Profile traffic
Enhanced doctor bios and team sections to build immediate patient trust
